name: wpovernight/out-the-door-order-tasks-workflows-for-woocommerce
description: Out the Door – Order Tasks & Workflows for WooCommerce

test:coverage: @php vendor/bin/phpcov merge build/coverage --html build/coverage/html --clover build/coverage/clover.xml --text php://stdout

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit suite, then the integration suite.
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit tests. Fast, no WordPress or database needed.
scripts-descriptions.test:install: Download WordPress and WooCommerce into build/wordpress/ for the integration suite. Not needed when the plugin sits inside a WordPress site next to WooCommerce.
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration tests against WordPress, WooCommerce and the wpo_otd_tests database (see tests/environment.php). Set WP_TESTS_HPOS=1 to store orders in HPOS tables.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run both suites with coverage and merge them into build/coverage/ (HTML + Clover). Needs Xdebug or PCOV.
